license_required.quote: A person must be certified or registered in order to engage in the business of contracting in this state.

issuing_authority.quote: there is created within the department the Construction Industry Licensing Board

name.quote: there is created within the department the Construction Industry Licensing Board

type.quote: The board shall consist of 18 members, of whom: (a) Four are primarily engaged in business as general contractors; ... (h) One is primarily engaged in business as a plumbing contractor

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Business and Professional Regulation
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the Department of Business and Professional Regulation.

degree_required.value: baccalaureate degree from an accredited 4-year college in the appropriate field of engineering, architecture, or building construction (with 1 year experience); OR 4 years active experience as worker/foreman; OR combination of experience and college-level credits
degree_required.quote: Has received a baccalaureate degree from an accredited 4-year college in the appropriate field of engineering, architecture, or building construction and has 1 year of proven experience in the category in which the person seeks to qualify.

degree_level.quote: Has a total of at least 4 years of active experience as a worker who has learned the trade by serving an apprenticeship as a skilled worker

school_approval_basis.quote: Has received a baccalaureate degree from an accredited 4-year college in the appropriate field of engineering, architecture, or building construction

credential_pegged.quote: Has received a baccalaureate degree from an accredited 4-year college in the appropriate field of engineering, architecture, or building construction and has 1 year of proven experience

required.quote: Has a total of at least 4 years of active experience as a worker who has learned the trade by serving an apprenticeship as a skilled worker who is able to command the rate of a mechanic in the particular trade or as a foreman

experience_source.quote: Has a total of at least 4 years of active experience as a worker who has learned the trade by serving an apprenticeship as a skilled worker who is able to command the rate of a mechanic in the particular trade or as a foreman who is in charge of a group of workers

duration.value: 4 years (with at least 1 year as foreman); or 1 year degree + 1 year experience; or combination
duration.quote: Has a total of at least 4 years of active experience as a worker who has learned the trade by serving an apprenticeship as a skilled worker who is able to command the rate of a mechanic in the particular trade or as a foreman who is in charge of a group of workers and usually is responsible to a superintendent or a contractor or his or her equivalent; provided, however, that at least 1 year of active experience shall be as a foreman.

kind.value: trade experience as skilled worker and/or foreman in the plumbing trade
kind.quote: active experience as a worker who has learned the trade by serving an apprenticeship as a skilled worker who is able to command the rate of a mechanic in the particular trade or as a foreman

exams.name: Plumbing contractor examination
exams.notes: Board-approved examination; applicants with a baccalaureate in building construction with 3.0+ GPA need only take business and finance portion
exams.quote: Any person who desires to engage in contracting on a statewide basis shall, as a prerequisite thereto, establish his or her competency and qualifications to be certified pursuant to this part. To establish competency, a person shall pass the appropriate examination approved by the board and certified by the department.

interval_years.quote: Each certificateholder or registrant who desires to continue as a certificateholder or registrant shall renew the certificate or registration every 2 years.

required.quote: Each certificateholder or registrant shall provide proof, in a form established by rule of the board, that the certificateholder or registrant has completed at least 14 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium since the issuance or renewal of the certificate or registration.

hours_per_period.quote: completed at least 14 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium

period_years.quote: completed at least 14 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium since the issuance or renewal of the certificate or registration

topical_requirements.quote: a portion of the required 14 hours must deal with the subject of workers' compensation, business practices, workplace safety, and, for applicable licensure categories, wind mitigation methodologies, and 1 hour of which must deal with laws and rules

available.quote: The board shall certify as qualified for certification by endorsement any applicant who: (a) Meets the requirements for certification as set forth in this section; has passed a national, regional, state, or United States territorial licensing examination that is substantially equivalent to the examination required by this part

requirements.value: Applicant must meet FL certification requirements and have passed a substantially equivalent exam, OR hold a valid license from another state/territory with substantially equivalent criteria, OR hold a valid license from a state with a reciprocal agreement, OR have held a valid license in another state for at least 10 years.
requirements.quote: Holds a valid license to practice contracting issued by another state or territory of the United States, if the criteria for issuance of such license were substantially equivalent to Florida's current certification criteria

exists.quote: The board shall consist of 18 members, of whom: ... (h) One is primarily engaged in business as a plumbing contractor

regulatory_model.quote: A person must be certified or registered in order to engage in the business of contracting in this state.

credential_type.quote: "Certified contractor" means any contractor who possesses a certificate of competency issued by the department and who shall be allowed to contract in any jurisdiction in the state

is_mandatory.quote: No person may engage in the business of contracting in this state without first being certified or registered in the proper classification.

title_protection.quote: No person shall: (a) Falsely hold himself or herself or a business organization out as a licensee, certificateholder, or registrant

scope_protection.quote: No person may engage in the business of contracting in this state without first being certified or registered in the proper classification.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a certificate or registration by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a certificate or registration by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of a crime that directly relates to contracting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of contracting or the ability to practice contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any act which assists a person or entity in engaging in prohibited uncertified/unregistered contracting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any act which assists a person or entity in engaging in the prohibited uncertified and unregistered practice of contracting, if the certificateholder or registrant knows or has reasonable grounds to know that the person or entity was uncertified and unregistered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly combining or conspiring with an uncertified person by allowing certificate to be used with intent to evade the law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly combining or conspiring with an uncertified or unregistered person by allowing his or her certificate or registration to be used by the uncertified or unregistered person with intent to evade the provisions of this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting as a contractor under any certificate except in the name as set forth on the issued certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any certificate or registration issued hereunder except in the name of the certificateholder or registrant as set forth on the issued certificate or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing mismanagement or misconduct in the practice of contracting that causes financial harm to a customer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing mismanagement or misconduct in the practice of contracting that causes financial harm to a customer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by any municipality or county for an act or violation of this part
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being disciplined by any municipality or county for an act or violation of this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this part or violating a rule or lawful order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this part or violating a rule or lawful order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning a construction project in which the contractor is engaged or under contract
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandoning a construction project in which the contractor is engaged or under contract as a contractor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing a statement falsely indicating the work is bonded or that workers' compensation and public liability insurance are provided
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing a statement with respect to a project or contract falsely indicating that the work is bonded; falsely indicating that payment has been made for all subcontracted work, labor, and materials which results in a financial loss to the owner, purchaser, or contractor; or falsely indicating that workers' compensation and public liability insurance are provided.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud or deceit in the practice of contracting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing fraud or deceit in the practice of contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing incompetency or misconduct in the practice of contracting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing incompetency or misconduct in the practice of contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing gross negligence, repeated negligence, or negligence resulting in significant danger to life or property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing gross negligence, repeated negligence, or negligence resulting in a significant danger to life or property.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Proceeding on any job without obtaining applicable local building department permits and inspections
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Proceeding on any job without obtaining applicable local building department permits and inspections.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intimidating, threatening, coercing, or otherwise discouraging service of a notice to owner or notice to contractor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intimidating, threatening, coercing, or otherwise discouraging the service of a notice to owner under part I of chapter 713 or a notice to contractor under chapter 255 or part I of chapter 713.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to satisfy within a reasonable time the terms of a civil judgment related to the practice of the licensee's profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to satisfy within a reasonable time, the terms of a civil judgment obtained against the licensee, or the business organization qualified by the licensee, relating to the practice of the licensee's profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing misapplication of construction funds in violation of s. 713.345
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing misapplication of construction funds in violation of s. 713.345.

bonding_required.quote: To require one bond for each contractor in an amount not to exceed $5,000, which bond shall be conditioned only upon compliance with the Florida Building Code

insurance_required.quote: the applicant shall submit an affidavit on a form provided by the board attesting to the fact that the applicant has obtained workers' compensation insurance as required by chapter 440, public liability insurance, and property damage insurance for the safety and welfare of the public

definition_quote.value: "Plumbing contractor" means a contractor whose services are unlimited in the plumbing trade and includes contracting business consisting of the execution of contracts requiring the experience, financial means, knowledge, and skill to install, maintain, repair, alter, extend, or, if not prohibited by law, design plumbing.
definition_quote.quote: "Plumbing contractor" means a contractor whose services are unlimited in the plumbing trade and includes contracting business consisting of the execution of contracts requiring the experience, financial means, knowledge, and skill to install, maintain, repair, alter, extend, or, if not prohibited by law, design plumbing.

methods_authorized.quote: the execution of contracts requiring the experience, financial means, knowledge, and skill to install, maintain, repair, alter, extend, or, if not prohibited by law, design plumbing

license_tiers.quote: "Certified contractor" means any contractor who possesses a certificate of competency issued by the department and who shall be allowed to contract in any jurisdiction in the state without being required to fulfill the competency requirements of that jurisdiction.

value: scored at least 75 percent on a proctored journeyman examination approved by the board
completed a registered and state-approved apprenticeship program
has at least 12,000 hours of on-the-job training in the specific trade
journeyman_experience_pathways.quote: Has scored at least 70 percent, or after October 1, 1997, at least 75 percent, on a proctored journeyman Block and Associates examination or other proctored examination approved by the board for the trade in which he or she is licensed; Has completed a registered and state-approved apprenticeship program as defined in s. 446.021(6) or has at least 12,000 hours of on-the-job training in his or her specific trade

expedited_licensure_pathway_available.quote: If an applicant has received a baccalaureate degree in building construction from an accredited 4-year college, or a related degree as approved by the board by rule, and has a grade point average of 3.0 or higher, such applicant is only required to take and pass the business and finance portion of the examination.

gas_supply_work_included_in_scope.quote: including the installation of water, natural gas, liquefied petroleum gas and related venting, and storm and sanitary sewer lines

natural_gas_appliance_certification_requ.quote: any plumbing contractor who wishes to engage in the business of installation, improvement, repair, or maintenance of any tubing, pipe, or similar conduit used to transport gaseous or partly gaseous substances for medical purposes shall take, as part of the contractor's continuing education requirement, at least once during the holding of such license, a course of at least 6 hours

fire_sprinkler_work_authorized.quote: fire line standpipes and fire sprinklers if authorized by law

natural_gas_facilities_installation_auth.quote: including the installation of water, natural gas, liquefied petroleum gas and related venting, and storm and sanitary sewer lines

contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.quote: A qualifying agent must be certified or registered under this part in order for the business organization to operate in the category of contracting in which the qualifying agent is certified or registered.

qualifier_replacement_notice_days.quote: if the qualifying agent is the only certified or registered contractor affiliated with the business organization, the business organization shall notify the department of the termination of the qualifying agent and shall have 60 days from the termination of the qualifying agent's affiliation with the business organization in which to employ another qualifying agent

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: the business organization shall notify the department of the termination of the qualifying agent and shall have 60 days from the termination of the qualifying agent's affiliation with the business organization in which to employ another qualifying agent

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: Any work or operation of a casual, minor, or inconsequential nature in which the aggregate contract price for labor, materials, and all other items is less than $2,500

small_project_dollar_threshold.quote: Any work or operation of a casual, minor, or inconsequential nature in which the aggregate contract price for labor, materials, and all other items is less than $2,500
